dct_title_s: Natural Reserve Area Boundaries (Digital Map Database of China)
dct_description_sm: Abstract: This polyline layer describes nature reserve boundaries throughout China.

Purpose: This data is intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and to provide users with geographic data for cartography, environmental monitoring, management and impact analysis, economic analysis and other types of geographic analysis. Data can be used with geographic information systems (GIS) software to display and analyze information on natural resource assessment and management and associated areas of interest, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data.
